summary: Tested the agent client dates fix end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass for /api/public/agent-my-clients (start_date/end_date returned for every client), /api/public/agent-update-client/{id} (dates persist on user record), /api/admin/migrate-user-dates (backfills, requires admin). Frontend: complete flow on /CreateAccount works — PIN gate (8971), agent login (marco/agent123), 'I Miei Clienti' shows dates in DD/MM/YYYY format ('15/03/2024 — 20/07/2025'), edit form pre-populates start/end date inputs from client record, save updates the user record AND the list view reflects new dates immediately ('10/05/2024 — 25/08/2025') with 'Cliente aggiornato!' toast.

issues: Dates rendered with textMuted (light gray) — readable but lower contrast than other meta fields; consider matching the muted-foreground token used elsewhere

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:589-654 — agent_my_clients correctly reads dates from user record first and falls back to transactions, plus backfills the user record on the fly. Good.

server.py:656-733 — agent_update_client keeps transaction_start_date/transaction_end_date in the update dict (no longer popped), so PUT persists on user. The date-redistribute block also updates per-transaction dates when both dates are provided.

server.py:3539-3568 — migrate-user-dates endpoint only backfills users that already have transactions; users with zero transactions will still have empty dates after migration. Frontend handles this with 'No dates' placeholder so behavior is acceptable, but the migrate endpoint will not 'fix' truly empty users.

models.py:141-146, 170-171, 210-213 — User, UserCreate(?) and UserUpdate now expose transaction_start_date/transaction_end_date as Optional[str]. No regex validation on YYYY-MM-DD format; agent_update_client also does not validate the format before storing — a malformed string would be persisted and then `new Date(client.start_date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB')` would render 'Invalid Date' in the UI. Low risk since the date input enforces format, but consider adding light validation server-side.
CreateAccountPage.js:593-599 — display logic correctly shows DD/MM/YYYY (toLocaleDateString en-GB) when both dates present and amber 'No dates' otherwise.
CreateAccountPage.js:307-318 — startEdit correctly maps client.start_date/end_date back to transaction_start_date/transaction_end_date for the form payload.
Bot-detection middleware still blocks plain curl as expected; tests use a browser UA header.

test_credentials.note: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still lists the OLD access code 'DMTL610Q' — the actual ACCESS_CODE in backend/.env is 'zenthos2026'. Update test_credentials.md and add agent + agent-PIN credentials.
